grammar.k: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense) - 持续性
grammar.f: 主语 + have/has + been + 地点/介词短语 + for/since + 时间段
grammar.d: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作或状态持续到现在，常与for和since连用。结构为：主语 + have/has + been + 介词短语/过去分词短语 用于描述过去开始并持续到现在的情况，常与表示一段时间的时间状语连用
ex: He has been there for six months.
他在那里已经六个月了。
She has been a teacher for ten years.

grammar.k: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense) - 经历
grammar.f: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + (时间/地点状语)
grammar.d: 现在完成时表示过去的经历，常与ever, never, already, just等副词连用。结构为：主语 + have/has + 过去分词 用于描述过去的经历对现在的影响，或表示某动作已完成
ex: He has already visited many places.
他已经参观了很多地方。
He has never been abroad before.
He has just bought a car.

grammar.k: 一般将来时 (will + 动词原形)
grammar.f: 主语 + will + 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.d: 表示将来要发生的动作或状态，常与soon, tomorrow, next week等表示将来的时间状语连用 用于描述将来的计划、决定或预测
ex: 他很快就要访问达尔文了。
She will fly to London tomorrow.

patterns.p: I have just + 过去分词
o: I have just received a letter from my brother.
我刚收到哥哥的一封信。
im: I have just finished my homework.
She has just arrived at the station.

patterns.p: 主语 + has/have been + 地点 + for + 时间段
o: He has been there for six months.
他在那里已经六个月了。
im: She has been in Shanghai for three years.
They have been at this school for five months.
他们在这所学校已经五个月了。

patterns.p: 主语 + has/have already + 过去分词
o: He has already visited many places.
他已经参观了很多地方。
im: I have already read this book.
They have already left for Beijing.
他们已经出发去北京了。

patterns.p: 主语 + has/have never + 过去分词 + before
o: He has never been abroad before.
im: I have never been to Japan before.
She has never tried Chinese food before.
